accuracy.title: An accurate reading starts with accurate ganji
accuracy.sub: A Saju reading has two stages: computing the ganji (the chart) and interpreting it. If the foundation — the ganji — is wrong, even the most eloquent interpretation is ultimately nonsense.
accuracy.band.title: Ask ChatGPT for your Saju, and the chart itself comes out wrong
accuracy.band.desc: Chat AIs can't compute the perpetual calendar — they merely guess your ganji in a plausible-sounding way. And with the wrong chart, the entire reading describes someone else's destiny. Tao Fortune first builds your chart from a precision calendar database — the 60 ganji, 24 solar terms, and lunar–solar conversion all accounted for — then lets AI handle only the interpretation.
accuracy.band.more: Why we're more accurate — learn more
accuracy.step.title: A reading has two stages
accuracy.step.1.d: Setting the four pillars (year, month, day, hour ganji) from your birth data. This is astronomy and calendar math — there is exactly one correct answer.
accuracy.step.2.d: Interpreting wealth, love, health and more from the chart. This is where rich language and insight matter.
accuracy.step.note: If ① is wrong, ② becomes “eloquently written nonsense.” The accurate foundation must come first.
accuracy.why.title: Why do LLMs so often get ganji wrong?
accuracy.why.lead: LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude are writers, not calculators. They produce fluent prose, but are structurally weak at precise astronomical and arithmetic computation.
accuracy.why.1.t: Solar terms are astronomy, not the calendar
accuracy.why.1.d: The year pillar changes at ipchun, not Jan 1; the month pillar changes at the 24 solar terms. These moments are fixed by the sun's ecliptic longitude and differ to the minute each year. Approximating them breaks the month pillar on boundary dates.
accuracy.why.2.d: Lunar month lengths and leap months are set by actual new moons and solar terms — astronomical events with no closed formula, requiring precise tables. LLMs can't reproduce them reliably.
accuracy.why.3.t: The day pillar is cumulative arithmetic
accuracy.why.3.d: The day pillar is the total days since an epoch, mod 60. Faking tens of thousands of days of integer math “in your head” means a single day's error flips the entire day pillar.
accuracy.why.4.d: An LLM states a wrong ganji as fluently as a right one and never checks its own work — producing results that look authoritative but are wrong.
accuracy.our.title: So here's how Tao Fortune does it
accuracy.our.1.d: We compute your chart from a precise perpetual-calendar database with solar terms, true solar time and lunar–solar conversion built in — equally accurate whether you enter a solar or lunar date.
accuracy.our.2.d: Only on a correctly built chart does the AI add deep interpretation. The AI focuses on what it does best — rich reading — not computation.
accuracy.our.quote: “Rich interpretation on an accurate foundation.” That is what a truly accurate reading requires.

landing.tojung.h1: 2026 Tojeong Bigyeol — Preview the Luck of Your Year Ahead
landing.tojung.intro: Tojeong Bigyeol is a traditional Korean yearly fortune that dates back to the Joseon-era scholar Tojeong Yi Ji-ham. Taoist analyzes your birth date and birth time with Saju (Korean four-pillars astrology) to map out your 2026 flow — the Year of the Red Horse (Byeong-o) — completely free.
landing.tojung.whatBody:
Tojeong Bigyeol is a traditional reading that combines the year's heavenly stem and earthly branch with your personal Saju to reveal the broad arc of your year and the fortune of each month.
Koreans have long consulted it at the start of the new year to prepare ahead, with guidance covering wealth, health, relationships, and disputes across everyday life.
landing.tojung.howTitle: How to Read Your Tojeong Bigyeol
landing.tojung.howBody:
Just enter your birth date (solar or lunar) and birth time. If you don't know your birth time, you can leave it as unknown and still get a reading.
Taoist builds an accurate Saju chart using the Manseryeok almanac, then compares it against the energy of 2026 (the Year of the Red Horse) to unfold your overall and month-by-month fortune.
landing.tojung.sampleBody:
Overall: A busy year, but one that bears fruit. The effort you sow in the first half ripens into wealth in the second.
March: New connections and opportunities arrive — don't hesitate. July: A time to watch both your health and your spending.
landing.tojung.faqA1: Yes. Taoist's core 2026 Tojeong Bigyeol reading is free to view, with no sign-up required.
landing.tojung.faqQ2: Can I get a reading without knowing my birth time?
landing.tojung.faqA2: Absolutely. If you don't know your birth time, leave it as 'unknown' and we'll read your yearly flow from your birth date. Knowing your birth time simply makes the analysis more precise.
landing.tojung.faqQ3: Should I enter a solar or lunar birth date?
landing.tojung.faqA3: Either works. When you enter your date, just select solar or lunar and the Manseryeok almanac converts it accurately for the calculation.
landing.tojung.faqQ4: How is the New Year fortune different from Tojeong Bigyeol?
landing.tojung.faqA4: Tojeong Bigyeol is closer to the traditional month-by-month reading, while the New Year fortune uses your full Saju for an in-depth AI analysis by theme (wealth, love, career, and more).
seo.landing.newyear.title: 2026 New Year Fortune — AI Saju Reading | Taoist
seo.landing.newyear.desc: Get an in-depth 2026 Saju reading for the Year of the Red Horse (Byeong-o). See your year's flow by theme — wealth, love, career, health — plus your luckiest times, with Korean four-pillars astrology.
landing.newyear.h1: 2026 New Year Fortune — What Awaits You This Year
landing.newyear.intro: The New Year fortune reads the flow of your year ahead in 2026 — the Year of the Red Horse (Byeong-o) — theme by theme, based on your Saju chart. From wealth and love to career, health, and relationships, our AI analyzes it all in depth.
landing.newyear.whatTitle: What Is the New Year Fortune?
landing.newyear.whatBody:
The New Year fortune (your fortune for this year) compares the year's annual luck with your personal Saju to reveal the opportunities and cautions ahead.
It helps you gauge when to take action, which months to be careful, and when wealth and new connections are most likely to arrive.
landing.newyear.howTitle: How to Read Your New Year Fortune
landing.newyear.howBody:
Enter your birth date and birth time, and the Manseryeok almanac builds an accurate Saju chart. We then compare it against the heavenly stem and earthly branch energy of 2026 (the Year of the Red Horse) to derive your fortune by area.
Taoist breaks the results down into wealth, love, career, and health, complete with timing-based advice.
landing.newyear.sampleBody:
Wealth: A year when doors open to extra income beyond your steady earnings. Opportunities cluster in spring and late autumn.
Love: A time to deepen existing bonds rather than chase new ones. Career: Your reputation grows by building substance rather than switching jobs or expanding.
landing.newyear.faqQ1: Is the New Year fortune paid?
landing.newyear.faqA1: The New Year fortune is a premium reading where our AI analyzes your full Saju in depth. You can try our free readings first to get a feel before upgrading.
landing.newyear.faqA2: 2026 is Byeong-o (丙午), the Year of the Red Horse. With strong fire (火) energy, it's read as a year that highlights activity and drive.
landing.newyear.faqQ3: Can I read it alongside Tojeong Bigyeol?
landing.newyear.faqA3: Yes. Use Tojeong Bigyeol for your month-by-month reading and the New Year fortune for in-depth flow by area — together they help you prepare for the year from every angle.
landing.newyear.faqQ4: Is it less accurate if I don't know my birth time?
landing.newyear.faqA4: Knowing your birth time adds the hour pillar for greater precision. If you don't know it, leave it as 'unknown' and we'll still deliver a meaningful reading based on your year, month, and day.
seo.landing.lifetime.title: Lifetime Fortune — Your Life Path by AI Saju | Taoist
seo.landing.lifetime.desc: Discover your lifetime fortune through the Saju (Korean four-pillars astrology) you were born with. Our AI reads your personality, talents, wealth, love, and health, along with the grand flow of your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles), to chart your life's map.
landing.lifetime.h1: Lifetime Fortune — The Life Map Drawn by Your Saju
landing.lifetime.intro: Lifetime fortune reads the temperament you were born with and the broad arc of your whole life, based on the Saju chart of the moment you were born. It even traces your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles), drawing a map of your life.
landing.lifetime.whatBody:
Lifetime fortune reads your innate personality, talents, capacity for wealth, and the texture of your relationships through the balance of the Five Elements held in your four pillars — the year, month, day, and hour of your Saju.
It goes further to examine the flow of your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles), gauging when you're on the rise and when it's time to consolidate.
landing.lifetime.howTitle: How to Read Your Lifetime Fortune
landing.lifetime.howBody:
Enter your birth date and birth time, and the Manseryeok almanac calculates your precise Saju chart and Dae-un (10-year luck cycles).
Taoist analyzes the balance of your Five Elements — strong or weak day master — to read your personality, career, wealth, love, and health, along with advice for each stage of life.
landing.lifetime.sampleBody:
Temperament: A Saju anchored by fire (火) energy, giving you strong drive and expressiveness.
Dae-un: From your mid-thirties, you enter a roughly 20-year rising cycle where wealth and reputation climb together. For health, reinforcing water (水) energy in midlife and beyond is key.
landing.lifetime.faqQ1: Is lifetime fortune different from the New Year fortune?
landing.lifetime.faqA1: Lifetime fortune covers the broad arc of your entire life and your innate temperament, while the New Year fortune reads a single specific year. Use lifetime fortune for the big map, and the New Year fortune for that year's path.
landing.lifetime.faqQ2: Does it tell me my Dae-un?
landing.lifetime.faqA2: Yes. Using the Manseryeok almanac, we calculate your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles) and guide you through life's rising and consolidating phases stage by stage.
landing.lifetime.faqQ3: Can I read it without knowing my birth time?
landing.lifetime.faqA3: The broad flow can be read from your year, month, and day alone. That said, the hour pillar influences your later years, children, and career, so knowing it improves precision.
landing.lifetime.faqQ4: Do I only need to read my lifetime fortune once?
landing.lifetime.faqA4: Your birth chart never changes, so a single reading serves as a lifelong map. For the luck that shifts year to year, we recommend complementing it with the New Year fortune.

landing.lotto.h1: Lotto Fortune — The Lucky Numbers Your Saju Calls For
landing.lotto.intro: Lotto fortune is a playful reading that combines the wealth energy of your Saju with the day's energy to gauge your lucky numbers and the best times for good fortune. Taoist picks your numbers for free.
landing.lotto.whatBody:
Lotto fortune combines the wealth-star energy of your personal Saju with the day's stem and branch to derive your lucky numbers and directions.
It doesn't guarantee a win, but it's a fun way to see when wealth energy is flowing in and which number patterns suit you.
landing.lotto.howTitle: How to Read Your Lotto Fortune
landing.lotto.howBody:
Enter your birth date and birth time, and we generate a lucky number combination based on your Saju chart and today's energy.
We suggest numbers tailored to each country's lottery format — 6/45 in Korea, Powerball in the US, ロト6 (Loto 6) in Japan, 大樂透 (Lotto) in Taiwan, and more.
landing.lotto.sampleBody:
Today's wealth luck: Energy gathers in the eastern direction and during the afternoon hours.
Recommended numbers (6/45): 7, 12, 23, 28, 36, 41 — the number pattern where your Saju's wealth star meets today's energy.
landing.lotto.faqA1: Yes, our Saju-based lucky number picks are free to use.
landing.lotto.faqA2: They're generated by a deterministic calculation that combines your personal Saju's wealth energy with the day's stem and branch. The same Saju on the same day always produces the same numbers.
landing.lotto.faqA3: No. Lotto fortune is content meant to be a fun look at the flow of luck, and it does not guarantee a win. Please enjoy it with a light heart.
landing.lotto.faqQ4: Does it work for other countries' lotteries?
landing.lotto.faqA4: Yes. We suggest numbers in the lottery format that fits your language and region — 6/45 in Korea, Powerball in the US, Loto 6 in Japan, Lotto in Taiwan, and more.

seo.landing.month.desc: Get this month's fortune analyzed free with Saju (Korean four-pillars astrology). See your month-long flow of wealth, love, work, and health, plus your good days and days to watch.
landing.month.h1: Monthly Fortune — Read the Flow of Your Month Ahead
landing.month.intro: Monthly fortune compares your Saju chart with this month's monthly luck to reveal your flow of wealth, love, work, and health over the month. Taoist unfolds it for you, for free.
landing.month.whatBody:
Monthly fortune combines the month's stem and branch with your personal Saju to read the month's fortune and your flow by area.
It helps you find the rhythm of your month — when to push a project forward, which days to be careful, and more.
landing.month.howTitle: How to Read Your Monthly Fortune
landing.month.howBody:
Enter your birth date and birth time, and we compare this month's monthly luck with your Saju to derive your fortune by area.
Taoist breaks it down into wealth, love, career, and health, offering your month's flow along with timing-based advice.
landing.month.sampleBody:
This month's overview: A month where small, welcome changes arrive amid stability.
Wealth: Don't miss the opportunities that come after mid-month. Love: Honest conversation deepens your relationship. Days to watch: Overwork and disputes near month's end.
landing.month.faqA1: Yes, the core Saju-based monthly fortune reading is free to view.
landing.month.faqQ2: Do I read it fresh each month?
landing.month.faqA2: Yes. Since the monthly luck changes every month, reading it anew each month lets you prepare for that month's flow.
landing.month.faqQ3: How is it different from the daily fortune?
landing.month.faqA3: The daily fortune reads a single day, while the monthly fortune reads the flow of a whole month. Read both to stay on top of your day and your month.
landing.month.faqQ4: Is it okay if I don't know my birth time?
landing.month.faqA4: Yes. Leave it as 'unknown' and we'll still read your month's flow; knowing your birth time simply makes it more precise.

seo.landing.date.desc: Will today's date go well? See today's love and romance fortune through Saju, with the best times and places, analyzed free by our AI.

landing.date.intro: Date fortune combines your Saju with today's energy to read your love and romance luck for the day. From the best time slots and moods to things to watch out for, Taoist tells you for free.
landing.date.whatBody:

landing.date.howTitle: How to Read Your Date Fortune
landing.date.howBody:

landing.date.sampleBody:

landing.date.faqA1: Yes, your Saju-based date fortune for today is free to view.
landing.date.faqQ2: Do I need my partner's Saju too?
landing.date.faqA2: The basic date fortune reads your Saju and today's energy. If you're curious about the compatibility between two people, try the Compatibility menu.
landing.date.faqA3: Yes. Since the day's energy shifts daily, you can read a fresh date fortune every day.
landing.date.faqQ4: Can it tell me a good day to confess?
landing.date.faqA4: You can gauge when the mood is favorable from the flow of today's romance luck. Take a light look before an important date.

aura.privacy.body:
Dolmadang Soft (the "Company") values the personal information of users of the Aura app service and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act. This policy applies only to the Aura app service.

1. Personal Information Collected and Purposes

ItemCategoryDetailsNotes
Face Reading & Palmistry AnalysisNot logged in (free)Face and hand images (processed on-device; uploaded only when saved)Analysis is processed on the device only
Logged in (saving results)Email, display name (provided by Google/Kakao OAuth), analysis result text, landmark coordinatesStored in Supabase
Error inquiries-Email addressFor handling inquiries
On-Device Processing Notice: The original images used for face-reading and palmistry analysis are not transmitted to any server. Analysis is performed only on the user's device through Google Gemma on-device AI.

2. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information

We retain personal information in order to save analysis results, and we destroy it without delay upon membership withdrawal. Where retention is required by law, we retain the information for the periods below.

  • Records on display and advertising: 6 months (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
  • Records on contracts or withdrawal of subscription: 5 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
  • Records on payment and supply of goods: 5 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)

3. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties

The Company does not provide personal information to third parties without the user's consent or a legal basis. Exceptions apply only in unavoidable cases, such as a request from an investigative agency pursuant to law.

4. Entrustment of Personal Information Processing

CategoryTrusteeEntrusted Task
AuthenticationGoogle LLCGoogle OAuth social login
AuthenticationKakao Corp.Kakao OAuth social login
DatabaseSupabase, Inc.Storage of member information and analysis results
PaymentToss PaymentsPayment processing for paid content

5. Rights of the Data Subject

Users may at any time request to (1) access, (2) correct, (3) delete, or (4) suspend the processing of their personal information. To request account deletion and data deletion, please use the Account Deletion Request page or contact us at the email address below.

6. Destruction of Personal Information

After the purpose has been achieved, the information of users who are not logged in is destroyed immediately, and the information of logged-in users is destroyed after membership withdrawal once any retention period required by relevant law has elapsed. Electronic files are deleted in a manner that makes recovery impossible.

7. Measures to Ensure Security

We take measures to protect personal information through the principle of on-device processing without transmitting original images to a server, social OAuth-based account management, and Supabase's encrypted storage policies.

8. Personal Information Protection Officer

Article 2 (Definitions) A "Member" means a person who agrees to these Terms and uses the Service, and "Content" means the AI face-reading and palmistry analysis results provided by the Company.

Article 3 (Effect and Amendment of Terms) These Terms take effect upon notice within the app. Material changes are announced 30 days before they take effect, and other changes are announced 7 days in advance.

aura.support.q1: Are my photos stored on a server?
aura.support.a1: No. The original face and hand images used for face-reading and palmistry analysis are not transmitted to a server. All image analysis is processed only on your device through Google Gemma on-device AI. Only when you choose to save your results are the analysis result text and landmark coordinate data stored in Supabase.
aura.support.q2: Do I have to log in to save my results?
aura.support.a2: Yes. The ability to save analysis results and view them again later is available only to members who have logged in with a Google or Kakao account. The analysis feature itself can be used for free without logging in.
aura.support.q3: Can I view my analysis history on other devices?
aura.support.a3: Yes. Analysis results for logged-in members are stored on the Supabase server, so you can view them on other devices as long as you sign in with the same account.
aura.support.q4: Why is the AI model so large? It takes a while to download.
aura.support.a4: Because the on-device AI (Google Gemma) runs directly on your device, an initial model file download (about 1–2GB) is required. After that, analysis runs quickly without any server connection, and once downloaded, you can use the analysis even while offline.
aura.support.a5: Aura's face-reading and palmistry results are entertainment content based on traditional physiognomy and palmistry. Please do not use them as a basis for medical, legal, or financial decisions, and use them for fun and reference only.
aura.support.q6: What happens if I delete my account?
aura.support.a6: When you delete your account, all analysis results, profile information, and OAuth connection details stored in Supabase are permanently deleted. Deleted data cannot be recovered, so please decide carefully. Requests are processed within 7 business days.
aura.support.q7: Why do you need camera permission?
aura.support.a7: Camera or photo access permission is required to capture your face in real time during face-reading analysis or to select a photo from your gallery. The permission is only activated when you use the analysis feature, and captured images are never transmitted off your device.
